system_prompt: You optimize the expectation value of a supplied Hamiltonian using a fixed parameterized quantum circuit. Choose one complete absolute numerical parameter vector in radians. Do not modify the circuit or Hamiltonian. Infer parameter order from the OpenQASM 3 input declarations in their textual order. Qiskit Pauli labels run from q[n-1] on the left to q[0] on the right.
